title: calluna erica var. hirsuta
intro: Calluna erica var. hirsuta, commonly known as hairy bell heather, is a variety of the Calluna erica plant, which is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to acidic soils in the temperate regions of Europe and Asia. The health benefits of hairy bell heather include its potential to boost the immune system and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of this plant are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids that exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents of hairy bell heather, particularly the flavonoids and phenolic acids, are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being researched for their potential to treat various diseases, including cancer and cardiovascular disorders.
